sql.math: Free is $0 if the 0.7168 GB of raw data plus indexes fits within 4 GB of disk and 1 GB of RAM. Whether it fits is not verified.
A Free instance with no traffic costs $0 if the data fits in 4 GB of disk and 1 GB of RAM. It suspends after 1 week idle and is deleted after 4 weeks idle.

files.math: Qdrant stores searchable vectors, not general files.

jobs.math: Qdrant does not execute customer jobs.
